root_cause.behavior: Candidate v5 intentionally routes any selected unit-conversion column containing TEXT/BLOB to B1 full-payload processing. The frozen fixture therefore does not enter the SQL window fast path.
root_cause.validation_scan: The reader still scans source rows through a bounded cursor for timestamp and warning validation. The frozen harness counter measures DataFrame materialization only; it does not measure total SQLite cursor rows.

gate_reason: The canonical frozen fixture did not reduce DataFrame materialization from 4096 rows to the 512 requested rows. No v5 timing or PSS claim is made.
